description: Live course catalogue for a bookings_live school (course ids, weeks, prices). Use returned course ids inside save_trip configuration.

country_code.description: Visitor country ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. NL). Affects fee display where applicable.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for prices in this call. Usually EUR.

locale.description: Response language and site context. One of en, nl, da, sv.

school_id.description: Craft CMS school entry id from search_language_schools hits (field school_id). Not the CRM UUID.

startDate.description: Course start calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). Typically a Monday from list_starting_dates.

name: list_courses

course_types.description: Course types with nested courses[] (course ids, weeks, week prices).

school.description: School metadata from the booking API.

start_date.description: Effective start date used for pricing (YYYY-MM-DD).
